question: Where did Sheikh Mujibur Rahman deliver his 7 March 1971 speech?

options.text: The Ramna Race Course, now Suhrawardy Udyan

explanation: Mujib gave the speech at the Ramna Race Course, now Suhrawardy Udyan, the same ground where the Pakistani surrender was signed on 16 December. UNESCO added the speech to its Memory of the World Register in 2017.
